title: Concrete masonry unit plus finishes.
officialText:
The equivalent thickness of concrete masonry assemblies, Tea, shall be computed as the sum of the equivalent thickness of the concrete masonry unit, Te, as determined by
Section 721.3.1.2, 721.3.1.3, or 721.3.1.4, plus the equivalent thickness of finishes, Tef, determined in accordance with Section 721.3.2:
Tea=Te+Tef (Equation 7-6)
